Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_FitnessXPMul: Multiplier for the Fitness XP earned from treadmill exercise. 1.0 = normal. Requires a game/server restart to take effect for characters who have already exercised this session.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_StrengthXPMu: Multiplier for the Strength XP earned from weighted treadmill training and benchpress reps. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_SprintingXPM: Multiplier for the Sprinting XP earned from treadmill cardio sessions. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_HeatMultipli: Multiplier for the body heat you generate while exercising (0 = no heat gain, 1 = normal, 2 = double heat gain).
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_ThirstMultip: Multiplier for the thirst you build up while exercising (0 = no thirst gain, 1 = normal, 2 = double thirst gain).
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_TreadmillDro: When a bag is automatically removed before using the treadmill, drop it on the floor instead of keeping it in your inventory. Has no effect if Keep Bags Equipped is on.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchpressDr: When a bag is automatically removed before using the benchpress, drop it on the floor instead of keeping it in your inventory. Has no effect if Keep Bags Equipped is on.
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchTreadKe: Keep worn backpacks and bags equipped during treadmill and benchpress exercise instead of automatically removing them first.
